privacy.title: Privacy
paragraphs: Alexandre Sequeira offers his services under the name ALSEQ DEV, from Niterói, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. For a question about this data: alseqdev@gmail.com.
The form asks for a name, an email address, and a message. The site also stores the page language, the date, and a fingerprint of the IP address. The IP address itself is not kept.
This information is used to read the request and reply to it. It is not sold and it is not used for advertising. The site does not measure its audience.
The message is kept for one year, then deleted. Before that, a request sent to alseqdev@gmail.com can ask to read it, correct it, or delete it.
A technical cookie protects the form. It does not follow browsing. There is no advertising cookie.
A click on WhatsApp opens the conversation on WhatsApp. Their service then applies.

In Brazil, this processing follows the Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados (LGPD). For a person in the European Union, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) also applies: access, rectification, erasure, restriction, objection, and a complaint to the authority in their country. The message is processed from Brazil.
